7457.title: Plugin interaction creation skips parent attention notifications
7457.rootCauseOneLine: Parent attention dispatch is called only by provider interaction registration; server-owned plugin interaction creation omits it.
7457.proposedFix: Share the existing attention notification helper between provider registration and plugin interaction creation, preserving auto/stuck/off and origin filters. Include the plugin request title and interaction ID without blocking the child.
7457.caveats: Server lifecycle reproduction with real migrated SQLite and captured host RPC delivery; no real ACP/GLM or Claude process, browser, historical 0.49.0 run, or ten-minute wait. Resolution notifications are separate scope (issue #3614).
